column7: Decides whether a task's settlement records a gateway refusal raised inside its dispatch, and with which code: only when the dispatch cell holds a refusal, never from the error code alone (a backend's own error with a refusal's code is not one); a refusal delivered as an isError result takes the firewall's code; a dispatch that still delivered a clean answer records nothing
Fail-closed read of the dispatch cell: with no cell the settlement records nothing, never a false not-refused
Runs each worker dispatch in a fresh delivery cell so a refusal raised inside it reaches the settlement record and a discarded attempt's refusal does not
